sql: SELECT year,COUNT(*) n FROM Movie WHERE substr(year,-4) NOT GLOB '[12][0-9][0-9][0-9]' GROUP BY year

WITH films AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT MID,CAST(substr(year,-4) AS INTEGER) y FROM Movie),credits AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) pid,f.y FROM M_Cast c JOIN films f ON c.MID=f.MID),ordered AS (SELECT pid,y,LAG(y) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY y) prev FROM credits),careers AS (SELECT pid,MIN(y) first_year,MAX(y) last_year,COUNT(*) years,COALESCE(MAX(y-prev),0) max_diff FROM ordered GROUP BY pid) SELECT max_diff,COUNT(*) actors,SUM(years=1) single_year FROM careers GROUP BY max_diff ORDER BY max_diff

WITH films AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT MID,CAST(substr(year,-4) AS INTEGER) y FROM Movie),credits AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) pid,f.y FROM M_Cast c JOIN films f ON c.MID=f.MID),ordered AS (SELECT pid,y,LAG(y) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY y) prev FROM credits),careers AS (SELECT pid,MIN(y) first_year,MAX(y) last_year,COUNT(*) years,COALESCE(MAX(y-prev),0) max_diff FROM ordered GROUP BY pid) SELECT * FROM careers WHERE max_diff=4 LIMIT 12

WITH pp AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM Person),cc AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast) SELECT COUNT(*) actors,SUM(p.PID IS NULL) missing_person FROM cc c LEFT JOIN pp p ON c.pid=p.PID

WITH films AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT MID,CAST(substr(year,-4) AS INTEGER) y FROM Movie),credits AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) pid,f.y FROM M_Cast c JOIN films f ON c.MID=f.MID),ordered AS (SELECT pid,y,LAG(y) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY y) prev FROM credits),careers AS (SELECT pid,MIN(y) first_year,MAX(y) last_year,COUNT(*) years,COALESCE(MAX(y-prev),0) max_diff FROM ordered GROUP BY pid) SELECT COUNT(*) actors_without_four_year_gap FROM careers WHERE max_diff<=4

SELECT 'cast_raw' kind,COUNT(DISTINCT PID) n FROM M_Cast UNION ALL SELECT 'cast_normalized',COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(PID)) FROM M_Cast UNION ALL SELECT 'persons',COUNT(DISTINCT PID) FROM Person UNION ALL SELECT 'credit_movie_join',COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID)) FROM M_Cast c JOIN Movie m ON c.MID=m.MID

WITH years AS (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) pid,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) y FROM M_Cast c JOIN Movie m ON c.MID=m.MID),o AS(SELECT pid,y,LAG(y) OVER(PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY y) prev FROM years),g AS(SELECT pid,COALESCE(MAX(y-prev),0) d FROM o GROUP BY pid) SELECT COUNT(*) all_actors,SUM(d<=3) incorrect_three_year_gap,SUM(d<=4) correct_max_three_missing_years,SUM(d=4) distinguishing_actors FROM g
SELECT MID,PID FROM M_Cast WHERE PID IS NULL OR TRIM(PID)=''

WITH films AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT MID,CAST(substr(year,-4) AS INTEGER) y FROM Movie),credits AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) pid,f.y FROM M_Cast c JOIN films f ON c.MID=f.MID WHERE c.PID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.PID)!=''),ordered AS (SELECT pid,y,LAG(y) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY y) prev FROM credits),careers AS (SELECT pid,MIN(y) first_year,MAX(y) last_year,COUNT(*) years,COALESCE(MAX(y-prev),0) max_diff FROM ordered GROUP BY pid) SELECT COUNT(*) actors_without_four_year_gap FROM careers WHERE max_diff<=4
